item.title: 2026-10-02-1300-front-desk-jobs
item.description:
Most clinic front desks lose hours every week to the same three jobs.
1. Answering website enquiries: AI sorts each message (booking, question, urgent) and replies using only your clinic's own details. Urgent messages go straight to staff. 2. Appointment reminders: an automatic email or SMS the day before, so fewer patients miss their slot. 3. Review requests: a polite follow-up after each visit with your Google review link.
We're building these as ready-to-import n8n workflows for clinics, and for the freelancers and agencies who set up automation for them.
Follow @frontdeskflows for the free sample when it's released.
